name: findenergyrates
description: Current US home electricity plans and rates by ZIP code, from FindEnergyRates.com. Read-only; no sign-in.

interface.longDescription:
FindEnergyRates gives ChatGPT current home electricity plans and rates in the deregulated US markets: Texas, Massachusetts, Ohio, Illinois, Pennsylvania, New Jersey, New York, Connecticut, Maryland, Delaware, New Hampshire and Washington, D.C.

Start with a ZIP code. The plugin finds the utility that serves it, returns ranked current plans (rate in cents per kWh, contract term, fees, renewable share, and a link to the plan page), and, in states that publish one, the utility's price to compare so you can see whether a supplier offer actually beats the default rate.

How it works
- Three read-only tools: find a utility by ZIP, search plans, get the price to compare. Nothing here enrolls you, submits a form, or quotes your bill.
- Plans are ranked by price only. Some plans pay FindEnergyRates when a customer enrolls; those are marked "referral" in the results and the payment never affects ranking.
- Links go to the plan's details page, not a checkout.
- Texas data is refreshed daily from the Public Utility Commission's Power to Choose feed; other states are refreshed on a regular schedule and each result carries its last-updated time.

FindEnergyRates is a licensed electricity broker in Texas only (PUCT BR250242). Outside Texas, results are listings of published supplier offers. No account or sign-in is required, and no personal information is collected beyond the ZIP code you ask about.
defaultPrompt: What are the cheapest 12-month electricity plans for ZIP 75001?
What is the price to compare for my utility in ZIP 19103?
Which utility serves ZIP 02108 and what plans are available?
